issue.title: Bump zod in contracts and drop the deprecated string format helpers
issue.description: zod 4.8 deprecates `z.string().url()` and friends in favour of `z.url()`. contracts/src uses the old form in a handful of schemas (stage.ts, api.ts). Bump zod in contracts/package.json and switch those call sites; no behaviour change. Done when `pnpm --filter @hardness/contracts test` and typecheck pass with no deprecation warnings.
